pages.title: GST two-rate structure proposal and state compensation

facts.text: GoM on Rate Rationalisation: chaired by Bihar Deputy CM Samrat Choudhary — accepted Centre's proposal
facts.head: News

facts.text: Keep: 5% and 18%; remove 12% and 28%
facts.head: News

facts.text: 99% of 12% items → 5%; 90% of 28% items → 18%
facts.head: News

facts.text: Sin goods (tobacco, cigarettes, online real-money gaming): new 40% slab
facts.head: News

facts.text: Compensation cess: to be abolished
facts.head: News

facts.text: Final say: GST Council (chaired by Union Finance Minister); meeting expected September 2025
facts.head: News

facts.text: PM Modi: hinted at a "Deepavali gift"
facts.head: News

facts.text: Concern: Kerala FM K.N. Balagopal — demanded compensation for states
facts.head: News

facts.text: GST introduced: 2017; current slabs 5, 12, 18, 28% + cess
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Average effective rate: ~11.5% → ~10%
facts.head: Revenue impact and compensation debate

facts.text: Revenue loss: ₹60,000–1,00,000 crore a year (0.2–0.3% of GDP); FY2025-26 ~₹45,000 crore
facts.head: Revenue impact and compensation debate

facts.text: 18% slab: ~70% of GST revenue — kept unchanged
facts.head: Revenue impact and compensation debate

facts.text: More affected: manufacturing/service states (Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu); 2018 rate cut caused 3–4% monthly dip
facts.head: Revenue impact and compensation debate

facts.text: Less affected: agrarian states (Bihar, UP, North-East)
facts.head: Revenue impact and compensation debate

facts.text: Old compensation: 5 years from July 2017, via compensation cess — ended June 2022
facts.head: Revenue impact and compensation debate

facts.text: Options: equalisation fund (like Kerala's flood cess), CFI grants, performance-linked transfers
facts.head: Revenue impact and compensation debate

facts.text: ⚠ GST Council works by consensus — voting rare
facts.head: Revenue impact and compensation debate

facts.head: Worst-hit sectors

facts.head: Worst-hit sectors

facts.text: Sector: Carpets; Exports to US: $1.2 billion; US share: 58.6%; Tariff before → now: 2.9% → 52.9%
facts.head: Worst-hit sectors

facts.text: Sector: Organic chemicals; Exports to US: $2.7 billion; US share: 13.2%; Tariff before → now: 4% → 54%
facts.head: Worst-hit sectors

facts.head: Worst-hit sectors

pages.title: Solar module manufacturing at 100 GW — oversupply risk

facts.text: Report: SBI Capital Markets (SBICAPS), August 2025
facts.head: News

facts.text: Module capacity: ~100 GW (2025); target 190 GW cumulative solar by 2027
facts.head: News

facts.text: Solar capacity growth: over 4,000% in a decade
facts.head: News

facts.text: FY25 installations: 24 GW, up 60% y-o-y (needing ~50 GWdc modules)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Q1 FY26: 11 GW — highest ever in a quarter
facts.head: News

facts.text: Imports FY25: ₹322 billion modules and cells (mostly China), down 38%
facts.head: News

facts.text: Exports: grew 23-fold FY22–FY24; 97% to the US — hit by end of Inflation Reduction Act subsidies and 'One Big Beautiful Bill'
facts.head: News

facts.text: Needed: 40–50 GW a year to 2030; 500 GW non-fossil by 2030
facts.head: News

facts.text: Firms: Waaree, Goldi Solar, Reliance, Emmvee, ReNew, Rayzon
facts.head: News

facts.text: Scheme: PLI for High Efficiency Solar PV Modules; Detail: ₹24,000 crore — Tranche I ₹4,500 crore (8,737 MW), Tranche II ₹19,500 crore (39,600 MW)
facts.head: Support schemes

facts.text: Scheme: ALMM; Detail: Approved List of Models and Manufacturers — restricts imports
facts.head: Support schemes

facts.text: Scheme: PM-KUSUM, PM Surya Ghar; Detail: demand for solar
facts.head: Support schemes

facts.text: ⚠ Exports went to the US, not the EU
facts.head: Support schemes

pages.title: SEBI proposes regulated venue for pre-listing trades

facts.text: Proposal: a "regulated venue" for trading shares before IPO listing — replace the grey market
facts.head: News

facts.text: Announced: at FICCI event, 21 August 2025 — SEBI Chairperson Tuhin Kanta Pandey, WTM Kamlesh Varshney
facts.head: News

facts.text: Grey market terms: Grey Market Premium (GMP); Kostak rate (premium for selling IPO application rights)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Aims: price discovery, tax compliance, investor protection
facts.head: News

facts.text: Also: longer tenure for equity derivatives (now weekly and monthly expiry); crackdown on misleading finfluencers
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Derivatives expire weekly/monthly, not quarterly
facts.head: News

pages.title: Cotton import duty of 11% withdrawn till 30 September

facts.text: Announced: 18 August 2025 — 11% cotton import duty withdrawn until 30 September 2025
facts.head: News

facts.text: Duty introduced: Union Budget 2021 (FM Nirmala Sitharaman) to protect farmers
facts.head: News

facts.text: Earlier exemption: April 2022 — till 30 Sept 2022, extended to 31 Oct 2022
facts.head: News

facts.text: Item: Cotton farmers; Detail: ~six million
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Item: 2024-25 production; Detail: 294 lakh bales — lowest in 15 years; need 318 lakh
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Item: 2021 production / need; Detail: 350 / 335 lakh bales
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Item: Imports; Detail: up 107.4% — $579.2 million (FY24) → $1.20 billion (FY25) (GTRI)
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Item: Import sources; Detail: Australia ($258.2 m), US ($234.1 m), Brazil ($180.8 m), Egypt ($116.3 m)
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Item: CCI MSP buying; Detail: 100 lakh bales, ₹37,500 crore; sold 73 lakh
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Item: MSP 2025-26; Detail: up 8%; season starts 1 October
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Industry asks: suspend duty April–September; 5% interest subvention for mills
facts.head: Data

pages.title: India's dairy model — competitiveness and challenges

facts.text: India: largest milk producer in the world — smallholder, cooperative-led
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Item: Farmgate cow milk price; India: ₹34/litre (Maharashtra, 3.5% fat, 8.5% SNF); Others: US ₹36.7; Europe ₹55.6
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Item: Yield per cow; India: 1.64 tonnes/year; Others: US 10.97, EU 7.33, NZ 4.6
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Item: Farmer share of retail price; India: 55–57%; Others: US 35%
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Item: Corn price; India: ₹22–23/kg; Others: US ₹15.4/kg
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Amul (GCMMF): pays ₹44–45/litre cow milk, ₹65–66/litre buffalo milk
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Competitiveness from: low labour costs, ⚠ not high yields
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Limit: India lacks land for New Zealand-style pasture dairying
facts.head: Facts

pages.title: Unified Pension Scheme — one-time switch to NPS

facts.text: Finance Ministry: one-time, one-way switch from UPS → NPS for Central govt employees
facts.head: News

facts.text: Deadline for switch: not later than 1 year before superannuation or 3 months before deemed retirement (VRS); irreversible
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Switch is back to NPS, not to OPS
facts.head: News

facts.text: Effective: 1 April 2025 — option under NPS with assured payout
facts.head: UPS features

facts.text: Gratuity: retirement and death gratuity extended
facts.head: UPS features

facts.text: Rules: CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021; CCS (Extraordinary Pension) Rules, 2023
facts.head: UPS features

facts.text: Tax: same Income Tax Act, 1961 benefits as NPS
facts.head: UPS features

facts.text: Uptake: 31,555 employees as of 20 July 2025; last date to enrol 30 September 2025
facts.head: UPS features

facts.text: Feature: Nature; OPS: Defined benefit; NPS: Defined contribution; UPS: Hybrid
facts.head: UPS features

facts.text: Feature: Pension; OPS: 50% of last pay; NPS: Market-linked; UPS: Assured
facts.head: UPS features

facts.text: Feature: Employee contribution; OPS: None; NPS: Yes; UPS: Yes
facts.head: UPS features

facts.text: NPS for govt employees: from 2004
